reviews.title: Expensive for no reason
reviews.comment: The AW420 is a standard 420mm AIO with a large cold plate that covers big Intel and AMD server and workstation CPUs.  A 420mm AIO for normal CPUs is less than half the price. The AW420 pump is in the radiator (not sure if this is good or bad but unnecessary).  The radiator is thin (bad).  The fans are nice (good). There are now "standard" AIOs like the be quiet! Silent Loop 3 with larger cold plates and mounting hardware for workstation/server sockets.  They perform as well or better for less than half the cost.
reviews.author: Scott Swanson
